subject: general
question: Which of the following options best defines 'Sustainable Development'?

options.text: Development that meets present needs without compromising future generations

solution:
The correct answer is __**Development that meets present needs without compromising future generations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sustainable development** refers to the practice of meeting current human needs while ensuring that natural resources and ecosystems are preserved for future generations.
 
• The concept was popularized by the **Brundtland Commission** in its 1987 report "Our Common Future."
 
• Sustainable development encompasses three main pillars: **economic growth, environmental protection, and social inclusion**.
 
• It emphasizes the need to balance economic progress with environmental sustainability and equity.
 
• The United Nations (UN) has outlined **17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, which serve as a global framework for achieving sustainable development by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brundtland Commission:**

 
 
• Also known as the **World Commission on Environment and Development** (WCED), it was established by the UN in 1983.
 
• Its 1987 report, "Our Common Future," provided the most widely recognized definition of sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The SDGs are a set of **17 global goals** adopted by the UN in 2015 to address critical issues like poverty, inequality, and climate change.
 
• Examples include **Goal 13: Climate Action** and **Goal 12: Responsible Consumption and Production**.
 
 
 
• **Key Principles of Sustainability:**
 
 
• Intergenerational equity: Ensuring resources are available for future generations.
 
• Precautionary approach: Taking proactive measures to prevent environmental degradation.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Sustainable Practices:**
 
 
• Using renewable energy sources like solar and wind power.
 
• Promoting sustainable agriculture and resource-efficient industries.
 
• Implementing waste reduction and recycling programs.
